messages:
lou (monitoring): ALERT: sudden spike in 429s for org_4721 starting at 1855001200 — rate-limiter returned THROTTLE_BUDGET_ZERO consistently
 tara (support): customer reported errors for embeddings endpoint, sending screenshot + request IDs
 ops-bot: incident channel auto-created: INCIDENT-1855 - possible quota enforcement regression
 maria (SRE): ack, investigating. Can someone pull recent config changes for org_4721?
 sanjay (platform): I see a config apply from console: cfg-8812 rolled last night 02:12 UTC, actor=kevin.console.canary
 kevin (console): that was the new "burst_multiplier" UX rollout. Default was meant to be blank (inherit), but canary had 'apply_to_legacy_keys' default true. Rolling back now if it's the culprit.
 beth (eng): looking at translation logs (config-translator): there are repeated exceptions when multiplier field is empty:
```
# config-translator snippet
val = payload.get('burst_multiplier')
# BUG: intended fallback 1, but code used -1
multiplier = int(val) if val else -1
burst_budget = base_budget * multiplier
```
beth (eng): because multiplier == -1, downstream clamp logic sets effective budget to 0 (clamped), causing immediate 429s under any spike
 maria (SRE): that explains why orgs with big burst reliance fell over. Which orgs hit the clamped path?
 lou (monitoring): currently 14 orgs show the pattern. Top affected: org_4721, org_9902. 429s peaked at +1200% for org_4721.
 kevin (console): starting emergency revert of the canary flag in console (reverting apply_to_legacy_keys default). Pushing rollback to canary group first.
 ops-bot: deploy-started by kevin on console-service at 1855001260
 beth (eng): preparing hotfix PR to change translator fallback to 1 and add schema validation; also adding unit tests for empty string case
 sanjay (platform): short-term patch at edge: if multiplier <= 0 then treat as 1 to avoid clamping. Pushing to rate-limiter config now:
`kubectl apply -f rate-limiter-guard.yaml --namespace=prod`
 lou (monitoring): after the edge patch, 429s for org_4721 started to drop at 1855001310, back to baseline by 1855001350 :thumbsup:
 tara (support): customers for affected orgs notified with ETA and follow-up. Received confirmation from customer ops that requests are succeeding again.
 kevin (console): canary revert complete at 1855001320. Full rollback scheduled to finish in 10m.
 ops-bot: deploy-finished console revert at 1855001325
 beth (eng): hotfix PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/config-translator/pulls/455 - patch changes `multiplier = int(val) if val else 1` and adds runtime schema check to reject negative or zero multipliers
 maria (SRE): good. post-incident actions: 1) patch rollout 2) schema checks in console (frontend & backend) 3) add alert for sudden mass clamp events 4) run a job to find orgs with multiplier<=0 historically and remediate
 kevin (console): opened tasks: PLAT-2317 (console: make burst multiplier explicit + no silent defaults), SRE-987 (alerts for clamp anomalies)
 beth (eng): adding integration test that simulates blank multiplier via console flow and verifies translator doesn't emit negative values. Will get PR merged by EOD.
 lou (monitoring): final metrics: affected requests 2.1M, failed 429s ~34k peak (0.8% of total at peak window). No data loss, latency unaffected otherwise.
 tara (support): drafting customer comms and incident summary to send to affected accounts.
 maria (SRE): root cause: translation fallback bug for empty multiplier field introduced during console UX rollout; secondary contributor: default apply-to-legacy flag enabled for canary, causing broader exposure.
 maria (SRE): immediate mitigation: console revert + rate-limiter guard. Long-term: validation and explicit defaults in console + translator.
 kevin (console): apologies for the UX default oversight. Will add non-empty numeric enforcement in the frontend and require explicit selection for "apply to legacy keys".
 beth (eng): also adding post-deploy smoke tests to catch config translation regressions earlier.
 lou (monitoring): closing alert at 1855001399 — system stable. Will attach graphs to incident ticket.
 ops-bot: INCIDENT-1855 marked resolved by maria at 1855001399
 maria (SRE): thanks team — will run a blameless postmortem doc and link here when ready
 tara (support): thanks everyone, closing loop with customers after PM doc posted
